semantic_review: All three sources read. BitVec64 fields are bijective and complete; finite decode scales are -1074 for exponent0 and exponent-1075 otherwise. Signed zeros, NaN payload/signaling and infinities preserved.

Genuine dependent word types distinguish all storage formats. Expr evaluation is compared with an independent result formula, universally quantified over explicit numerical callbacks. Boolean input normalization and full i8 store bytes are concrete.

All29 observed SSA profiles preserve ordered operands, direct integer-to-f64 and f64-output conversions, fp16/bf16 via fp32 on input, direct fp8 routes and fp8 RTNE. Literal route labels agree with Lean expectedRoutes.
runLane is a per-lane write request only, with explicit active absent-input and undefined-conversion outcomes. Externally provided masks are not a proved grid/address calculation.

No public specification or complete dtype/grid is added. Logical coverage remains160/217, and all57 remaining pairs remain pending. Native byte layout, memory, host, compiler, interleavings and fnuz rejected paths remain structural obligations.

Interpret each8/16/32/64-bit unsigned input and round directly to binary64; no fp32 intermediate.
Bind binary16-to-binary32 extension including signed zero, subnormals, infinities and NaN/payload policy.
Bind bfloat16-to-binary32 extension including signed zero, subnormals, infinities and NaN/payload policy.
Bind binary32-to-binary64 extension including specials and NaN/payload policy.
Bind direct E4M3FN-to-binary64 tt.fp_to_fp, including finite-only format and NaN policy.
Bind direct E5M2-to-binary64 tt.fp_to_fp, including subnormals, infinities and NaN policy.

Bind direct f64-to-signed8/16/32/64 rounding toward zero on its exact finite/range domain. None is explicit outside that domain; native poison/traps are a separate structural gap. Bool output uses signed8.
Bind direct f64-to-unsigned8/16/32/64 rounding toward zero on its exact finite/range domain. None is explicit outside that domain; native poison/traps are a separate structural gap.
Bind direct f64-to-binary16 truncf with specified rounding/overflow/underflow/NaN policy; no fp32 double-rounding route.
Bind direct f64-to-bfloat16 truncf with specified rounding/overflow/underflow/NaN policy; no fp32 double-rounding route.
Bind direct f64-to-binary32 truncf with specified rounding/overflow/underflow/NaN policy.
Bind direct f64-to-E4M3FN tt.fp_to_fp RTNE, including overflow/saturation and NaN policy. Existing fp32-input E4M3 software narrow does not establish this.
Bind direct f64-to-E5M2 tt.fp_to_fp RTNE, including subnormal/overflow/infinity/NaN policy.
Bind binary64 addition with exact rounding, signed-zero, subnormal/flush, overflow, infinity and NaN behavior for the intended target configuration.

remaining_structural_obligations.detail: Task-local Expr is separate from shared ComputeOp/FP.Structural. Raw-SSA dependency checks are observations, not a formal source extraction or compiler theorem.

remaining_structural_obligations.detail: runLane returns a requested write; it has no memory state, frame, alias model, block/grid iteration or scheduling theorem. The mask is externally supplied.

remaining_structural_obligations.gap: Native byte layout, allocations and finite addresses
remaining_structural_obligations.detail: Indexed bit widths do not bind physical storage/pointers/endianness, allocation extent, i32 pid/offset/mask arithmetic or address overflow.
Option and absent-input outcomes do not prove native poison propagation, trap/sanitizer behavior, wrapper dispatch, allocations or Python/Torch composition.
The two fnuz types remain outside these29 successful frontend routes. Their28 semantically promoted frontend rejection pairs still require explicit original-program contracts.
